CVE-2026-138150.title: SimGear through 2024.1.7 contains an infinite loop vulnerability  ...
CVE-2026-138150.description: SimGear through 2024.1.7 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in sgSimpleBuffer::resize() where an unsigned 32-bit wraparound in the size-doubling loop leaves the size at zero. Attackers can supply a crafted .btg scenery file with an oversized byte count exceeding 2^31 to hang the loading process in FlightGear.
